title: Volkswagen ID. Tiguan modelleri ID.4 ve ID.5'in yerini alıyor
summary: Volkswagen, ID.4 ve ID.5 modellerinin yerini alacak elektrikli ID. Tiguan SUV modelini doğruladı. Yeni araç 2027 başında Avrupa'da satışa sunulacak.
body:
Volkswagen, ID.4 ve ID.5 modellerinin yerini alacak yeni elektrikli SUV modelinin **Volkswagen ID. Tiguan** adıyla yollara çıkacağını doğruladı. İçten yanmalı motorlu standart Tiguan ile yan yana satılacak olan elektrikli model, ekim 2026 başında resmi olarak sergilenecek.

## Volkswagen ID. Tiguan tasarımı ve özellikleri

Paylaşılan ilk kamuflajlı görseller, aracın ID.4 ve ID.5'e kıyasla geleneksel Tiguan hatlarına daha sadık kaldığını gösteriyor. Ön kısımda ince LED farlar, gündüz seyir ışıkları ve hava perdeleri yer alırken; tavanda tavan rayları, alçak konumlandırılmış yan aynalar ve ID.4'teki gömme tasarımın aksine belirgin kapı kolları göze çarpıyor. Şirket ayrıca iki farklı ön tasarıma sahip prototip sergiledi. Bunlardan birinde dikey LED gündüz farları ve özel bir alt ızgara yer alıyor.

Araç, Alman üreticinin **MEB+** platformu üzerine inşa ediliyor. Mevcut ID.4 modelinde 58 kWh ve 79 kWh batarya seçenekleri sunulurken, ID. Tiguan modelinde daha verimli batarya paketlerinin kullanılması bekleniyor. Volkswagen, benzer bir isim stratejisini kısa süre önce ikonik hatchback modeli ID. Polo ile de uygulamıştı.

## Çıkış tarihi ve pazarlar

Volkswagen CEO'su Thomas Schäfer, yeni modelin çok yönlü ve premium bir elektrikli araç deneyimi sunacağını belirtti. Yapılan açıklamaya göre ID. Tiguan, 2027 yılının başında Avrupa pazarında satışa sunulacak. Kuzey Amerika pazarına ise daha sonraki bir tarihte ulaşacak.

**Neden önemli?** Volkswagen, elektrikli otomobillerinde alışılmadık tasarım ve isim kalıplarından vazgeçerek müşterilerinin yıllardır tanıdığı ikonik model isimlerine ve klasik SUV formuna geri dönüyor.

source_texts.text:
- The VW ID. Tiguan has been previewed with a bold new design.
- Underpinning the new electric SUV will be VW’s MEB+ platform.
- The EV will offer many of the same practicalities as the ICE model.
VW has confirmed recent reports that the ID.4 and ID.5 will be replaced by an all-new model, badged the ID. Tiguan. This new EV will be sold alongside the combustion-powered Tiguan and, following a lengthy period of development and teasing, will be unveiled in early October.
As we’ve seen from plenty of other car brands, VW has obviously decided it doesn’t need to position its electric models as completely different propositions from their combustion counterparts. By using a recognizable name for its latest EV, VW’s marketing team will no doubt be hopeful the ID. Tiguan will feel familiar to existing customers.
Watch: VW’s New ID. Tiguan Finally Stops Pretending It’s An ID.4
VW most recently adopted a similar approach with the ID. Polo, naming it after the brand’s most iconic pint-sized hatchback. In the case of the ID. Tiguan, it will land in European markets at the beginning of 2027. It will also be available in North America, although VW says it will arrive “at a later date,” without providing more details.
A More Traditional Design
Newly released photos of a lightly disguised ID. Tiguan prototype also gives us our best look at the SUV’s design. Compared to the ID.4 and ID.5 which looked completely unlike any other VW SUV, the ID. Tiguan will share similarities to the combustion-powered Tiguan.
The front of the new model features sleek LED headlights and daytime running lights, in addition to a black lower grille and a pair of small air curtains on the outer edges of the bumper. Other eye-catching elements include the low-set wing mirrors, the roof rails, and the chunky door handles, vastly different than the flap-style handles of the ID.4.
Plenty of changes have also been made at the rear, including a new bumper, tailgate, and window. The taillights of this prototype don’t appear to be production-spec units.
More: Volkswagen’s ID. Buzz Comeback Slips To 2028
Interestingly, VW has released images of two different versions of the ID. Tiguan, without specifying the differences. Whereas one has small air intakes positioned at the front, the other has vertical LED daytime running lights. It also has a unique lower grille.
What About The Hardware?
The ID. Tiguan is tipped to be built on VW’s MEB+ platform. Whereas the outgoing ID.4 is available with relatively small 58 kWh and 79 kWh batteries, we’d expect this new model to get larger and more efficient packs.
“Tiguan represents a versatile, premium vehicle and embodies the essence of True Volkswagen,” VW chief executive Thomas Schäfer said in a statement. “With the ID. Tiguan, we are carrying this product promise into the electric future. The all-electric model builds on the strengths of the bestseller and offers premium design, generous space, intuitive operation and innovative technologies. Together, both models form a strong offering for our customers’ different powertrain preferences.”
